description:
Your service records, kept forever. On your phone, not someone else's server.

Most car maintenance apps ask you to log in, sync to a server, and hope nothing breaks. One bad login and years of service history disappear. Glovebox works differently: no account, no server, no sync. Every oil change, tire rotation, and repair you log stays on your device, permanently.

WHAT IT DOES
- Log oil changes, tire rotations, brake jobs, inspections, and any other service, for any vehicle
- Get a reminder exactly when the next service is due, by date or mileage, whichever comes first
- See each vehicle's full maintenance history and service log at a glance
- Export your entire log to CSV anytime. Export is never paywalled or locked behind a subscription

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
No account. No login. No server. No sync to break. Your maintenance history cannot disappear because there's nothing to disappear from. It's saved right on your phone, the same way you'd keep a paper logbook in the glovebox.

BUILT FOR REAL CAR OWNERS
- Track unlimited service records for multiple vehicles
- Custom service intervals for oil changes, tire rotations, brake jobs, air filters, cabin filters, coolant flushes, and more
- Odometer based and date based due tracking, whichever comes first
- Dark, glare friendly design built for reading in the driveway, garage, or at the dealership

WHO IT'S FOR
Daily drivers, DIY mechanics, car flippers, and anyone who wants proof of maintenance history when it's time to sell. Keep every oil change record, repair note, and inspection date in one searchable log instead of a shoebox of paper receipts.

Free to start with one vehicle. Upgrade to Glovebox Pro for unlimited vehicles and custom service intervals. Export always stays free, for everyone.
